name: Filebase

evidence.files: C07: S3-compatible object storage buckets; F05: core S3 object operations supported

line: S3-compatible object storage and IPFS pinning with a built-in CDN.

free.text: 5 GB pooled; 1 bucket, 500 IPFS pins; no idle pause or deletion rule

cells.regions: S3 region auto; IPFS endpoint uses us-east-1

sql.math: Filebase provides object storage, not a database
Filebase provides object storage, not a database

files.math: The Pro plan includes 500 GB of shared storage, 1 million Class A requests and 10 million Class B requests. Paid S3 outbound data (egress) is free.

jobs.math: Filebase stores and delivers files; it does not run background jobs
